title: Password Security Testing Examples
title_es: Ejemplos de Testing de Seguridad de Contraseñas
description: Runnable password security test snippets: a Have I Been Pwned k-anonymity breach check, a NIST-style password policy validator and a Playwright rate-limit spec.
description_es: Snippets ejecutables de testing de seguridad de contraseñas: chequeo de brechas con k-anonymity de Have I Been Pwned, validador de política estilo NIST y spec de rate limiting en Playwright.
